lines: But when you notice the feeling,
you give space for new choices.
Sometimes, regret lives in the mind,
not in the actions you took.
It clings because you keep judging yourself.
Letting go does not erase the past.
Your mind can focus on what matters now.
Peace grows when you stop replaying.
